title: Customers
description: The people who buy from you — what they have booked, what they owe, and what they agreed to hear about.
emptyMessage: Attach a customer to a sale at the counter and they appear here.
emptyFiltered: Nothing matches that. Try a different search or segment.
addDescription: A phone number is what matches them next time they walk up.
phoneHelp: Any format — 01712-345678 and +8801712345678 match the same person.
tagsHelp: Separate with commas. Tags are how you build a group to export.
dupDescription: Two records for one person. Choose which one survives — the other folds into it.
dupMedium: Worth checking — a name on its own is not proof
dupNoneMessage: Nothing shares a phone number, email address or name right now.
mergeExplain: The surviving record keeps its own contact details, gains anything the other had, and takes over its orders. The other record stops appearing in lists.
notFoundMessage: This record may have been merged into another one.
erasedNotice: Personal data was erased on {when}. Orders are kept for the accounts; the identity is gone.
noOrdersMessage: Sales attached to this customer at the counter or online will show here.
consentExplain: Only send marketing to people who agreed to it. Every change is recorded below with who made it and when.
noteHelp: Internal only — the customer never sees this.
noNotesMessage: Write down anything the next person serving them should know.
flagDescription: The reason shows on this customer everywhere staff see them.
flagReasonHelp: Be specific and factual — other people will act on this.
mergeDescription: This record folds into the one you choose. Its orders move across.
eraseMessage: The name, phone, email, notes and consents are removed and cannot be brought back. Orders stay for the accounts, showing 'Erased customer'.
noMembershipMessage: Sell them a membership here or at the counter.
mResumed: Resumed — the paused time was added on.
mCancelDescription: It stays usable until {expires} and will not renew.
mCancelReasonHelp: This is the first thing anyone asks when they ring up later.
adjustPointsDescription: Every adjustment is recorded with your reason.
adjustAmountHelp: A negative number takes points away.
adjustNoteHelp: Goodwill after a cancelled session, a correction, and so on.
